h: Ebola patient evacuated from Nigeria on a medical flight as 53 contacts are isolated
p: A 42-year-old woman infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has reportedly been flown out of Abuja for treatment abroad. She is said to be married to a Swiss diplomat. Officials have identified 53 people who had contact with her and placed them in isolation.
more: The Bundibugyo strain was first recorded in a 2007 outbreak in Uganda.
The NCDC has urged the public to rely on official updates.
Contacts under monitoring are due weekly allowances, the agency has said.
